meaning.zh:
“开玩笑” 或 “胡闹”。

这个短语源自于马戏团里的小丑表演。他们通常会做一些滑稽的动作和搞笑的表演以娱乐观众。因此，“clown around” 已被用来形容那些在不合适的场合做可笑事情的人，或者用玩闹的方式来取乐自己和他人。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from clown performances in the circus. Clowns usually do ridiculous acts and perform comical tricks to entertain the audience. Therefore, "clown around" has come to describe people who do silly things, often in inappropriate situations, to amuse themselves and others.

lines.en: Stop clowning around and get to work.
lines.zh: 别再胡闹了，赶紧开始工作。

lines.en: The kids were clowning around during class, annoying the teacher.
lines.zh: 孩子们在上课时胡闹，让老师很烦恼。

lines.en: He likes to clown around to make his friends laugh.
lines.zh: 他喜欢胡闹来逗朋友们笑。
